baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening praise, the hand-malakut construction, the totalizer over thing, and the passive return to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Transcendence frames a chain in which effective sovereignty holds comprehensive dominion over every reportable entity, while the final passive redirects the addressees to the same sovereign source.

activation_trace.role: The branch of transcendence and exoneration makes the opening praise deny defect in the sovereignty that follows.
The hand as effective authority supplies the enforceable control expressed by the hand construction.
Kingship and sovereign rule make malakut the comprehensive domain governed by that authority.
The branch of encompassing all parts removes any residual entity from the domain.
The thing as whatever can be known and reported supplies the maximally general object of dominion.
Return or being restored to a prior direction gives the governed addressees their terminal movement back to Him.

changed_reading.before: A closing formula of praise followed by universal possession and homeward return.
changed_reading.after: Praise is warranted because every knowable entity lies inside one effective sovereignty and every addressee is redirected to its source.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of hand and malakut, followed by all and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: A physical handle branch of hand intersects the cohesion and linchpin branches of malakut: the whole created order is not merely owned but held at its operative point, kept coherent, and restorable to origin.

activation_trace.role: The hand as a handle or extremity contributes an operative point through which a thing can be grasped and directed.
The branch of strength, kneading, and cohesion makes malakut the maintained integrity of the order.
The linchpin on which an affair stands turns that integrity into the order's supporting control point.
Comprehensive inclusion extends the held coherence from selected beings to the entire order.
Restoration to a prior source supplies the recovery movement made possible by retained coherence.

changed_reading.before: All things are statically possessed by Him.
changed_reading.after: The coherence, operative grip, and recoverability of the whole order are held in Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus totality becomes an archival totality: deeds are entered, residual traces remain legible, every thing is exhaustively counted, and one common register gathers them. Return therefore carries retrieval into account, not only relocation.

activation_trace.role: The focus totalizer supplies the comprehensive scope that the earlier register fills with particulars.
The focus return supplies the endpoint at which retained particulars can be restored for account.
Entering a name into a register makes preservation formal rather than merely mnemonic.
A remaining mark that discloses what happened extends the account beyond deliberate deeds to their aftereffects.
The repeated comprehensive totalizer explicitly connects the register's scope to the focus totality.
Every knowable and reportable thing becomes a possible entry rather than an untracked remainder.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the mechanism by which comprehensive dominion remains inspectable.
An origin, gatherer, and reference point makes the single register a common repository for dispersed traces.

structural_cues: 36:12 moves from reviving the dead through what they sent ahead and what remained after them to every thing enumerated in one manifest register.
The exact all-thing pair of the focus already appears inside this preservation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, residual marks, exhaustive counting, and a common register; I infer that return includes retrieval into account. A live alternative is that the sequence proves knowledge without specifying a forensic process.

changed_reading.before: Every thing is under undifferentiated universal dominion.
changed_reading.after: Every deed and lingering consequence is retained within that dominion and can be brought back into a comprehensive account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return is oriented by origination and specified by assembly: the One who first brought the speaker forth is the destination, ordinary return to former peoples is denied, and all are instead gathered into immediate presence.

activation_trace.role: The focus restoration branch provides the movement whose destination and mode the context specifies.
Origination and first bringing-forth identify the source toward which the paired return is directed.
The same passive return beside origination binds endpoint to source before the focus repeats it.
Negated return to earlier peoples blocks an ordinary historical comeback as the final return's sense.
Comprehensive inclusion makes the coming assembly coextensive with the focus's every-thing scope.
Gathering dispersed members into one body supplies the collective mode of return.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness turn gathering into appearance before the sovereign.

structural_cues: 36:22 places origination and the same passive return in one clause.
36:31 denies return to destroyed generations, while 36:32 says all are gathered and brought into presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, blocked mundane return, universal gathering, and presence; I infer a creatorward assembly rather than a cycle back into society. The remaining alternative is a broad eschatological return whose precise mode stays unstated.

changed_reading.before: Return is an unspecified movement back.
changed_reading.after: Return is reorientation to the originator as dispersed generations are assembled into His presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Malakut changes from a static estate into an operating order: bodies run to set stations, measures regulate their courses, the moon returns through phases, and all swim without collision. Sovereignty is visible as sustained coordination.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign rule is the focus anchor whose mode changes from possession to active coordination.
Return in the focus becomes resonant with governed courses that arrive back at an assigned state.
Continuous flowing motion supplies a dynamic rather than static image of the governed domain.
Management by measure and deliberation supplies the regulating principle behind the motion.
Returning after departure gives the lunar sequence a recurrent trajectory that anticipates the focus return.
The all-totalizer generalizes coordinated motion across every member of the displayed system.
The celestial course supplies the bounded path within which each moving body is governed.
Swimming or running through a medium makes ordered motion the visible performance of dominion.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 sequence running, a settling point, measured stations, return, non-overtaking, a course, and universal swimming.
The motion branch of the focus opening recurs as a finite verb in 36:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trajectories, measure, recurrent phases, non-collision, and swimming; I infer that these instantiate malakut as live coordination and lend controlled-course resonance to return. The final return can still be eschatological rather than orbital.

changed_reading.before: Malakut is a static possession held by a ruler.
changed_reading.after: Malakut is the continuously maintained order in which distinct courses move, keep their limits, and return under one measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human body becomes an internal witness system: mouths are sealed, hands articulate, feet testify, and bodily acquisition is disclosed. The divine hand in the focus thus governs a return in which creaturely hands cannot conceal their own agency.

activation_trace.role: The divine hand as effective authority anchors the jurisdiction under which creaturely organs are made to disclose.
The focus return supplies the occasion on which embodied agency is restored into inspectable presence.
A preventing, secured seal disables the mouth's control over the account.
Intelligible speech linking speakers transfers disclosure from the sealed mouth to the hands.
The literal bodily hand supplies the organ that speaks inside the sovereign proceeding.
Declaration grounded in knowledge turns the body's evidence into testimony rather than mere animation.
The branch of acquiring limbs closes the mechanism by linking bodily organs to what the person acquired.

structural_cues: 36:65 transfers speech from sealed mouths to hands and testimony to feet, ending with what the persons used to acquire.
The context repeats the focus hand root while sharply distinguishing divine authority from human bodily agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sealed channel, speaking hands, witnessing feet, and acquired acts; I infer that return is a forensic self-disclosure under divine jurisdiction. The alternative is a discrete judgment scene with no intended hand-to-hand contrast.

changed_reading.before: Return places persons abstractly under universal sovereignty.
changed_reading.after: Return places embodied agents under a sovereignty that can make their own working organs disclose the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nearby counterfactual removes bodily form and locomotor capacity so that persons can neither proceed nor return. The focus passive then marks an agency reversal: the return to Him does not depend on their capacity to make a return.

activation_trace.role: The passive focus return anchors the destination while leaving the returning force outside the addressees.
Will attached to its object supplies the initiating condition that can override creaturely movement.
Transformation and distortion of bodily form provide the material interruption of autonomous agency.
Capacity to perform an act is explicitly removed, distinguishing voluntary locomotion from imposed return.
Passing onward supplies one blocked direction in the paired loss of movement.
Blocked self-return supplies the direct contrast that sharpens the later passive return to Him.

structural_cues: 36:67 conditions transformation on divine will and then denies both forward motion and return.
36:83 changes the same root to a passive second-person prediction directed to Him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine willing, bodily transformation, lost capacity, and blocked active return; I infer that the final passive signals compelled return independent of creaturely locomotion. The live alternative is that 36:67 concerns only earthly movement, though the agency contrast remains.

changed_reading.before: The addressees eventually make their way back to Him.
changed_reading.after: They will be returned to Him even when the very capacity to go forward or turn back is not theirs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places divine making by hands upstream of human ownership and makes usability depend on prior subjection. Human possession is therefore a granted interface inside the larger malakut, not a rival sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The focus hand as sovereign authority supplies the upstream control against which creaturely possession is measured.
Comprehensive kingship anchors the encompassing level within which local ownership operates.
Bringing the animals into existence places their source before the humans later called owners.
Intentional making supplies the productive act assigned to the divine hands.
Attributing work emphatically to hands marks direct divine agency upstream of human control.
Possession and disposition name the real but bounded ownership granted to the human beneficiaries.
Taming and easing after difficulty supplies the enabling act that makes human use possible.

structural_cues: 36:71 moves from divine creation and hand-work to humans being owners of the created animals.
36:72 immediately grounds riding and eating in the animals having first been subjected for them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine making, human ownership, and prior subjection; I infer a nested chain in which local ownership is delegated usability inside universal sovereignty. The alternative is a list of favors without a technical hierarchy of title.

changed_reading.before: Divine dominion and human ownership are separate assertions.
changed_reading.after: Human ownership is a downstream, enabled mode of use within the malakut held by the One who made and subjected its objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human traverses radically discontinuous material states, from a drop to articulated person to decayed bone, yet the first origination remains a repeatable act known across every creation. Return is therefore re-originating continuity, not reversal along an intact path.

activation_trace.role: The focus restoration branch supplies the return whose material feasibility the creation sequence tests.
Cohesion and maintained integrity allow malakut to hold identity across otherwise discontinuous material states.
A clear drop extending through the scale of water, including generative fluid, supplies the person's minimal first material state.
Loss of remembrance explains why the first transformation is omitted from the objection to another.
Decay and worn remains supply the apparently discontinuous terminal material from which return is doubted.
Bringing a thing newly into existence supplies the repeatable operation that answers material decay.
Beginning and precedence identify first origination as the operative precedent for return.
Comprehensive inclusion extends knowledge from one disputed body to every created configuration.
Creative bringing-forth names the class of states fully known by the originator.
Enabling capacity that reaches effective action supplies power to reproduce the created kind.
Repeated creative bringing-forth turns the first act into an explicit warrant for another creation.

structural_cues: 36:77-79 place the forgotten first creation from a drop against the objection from decayed bones, then answer by first origination and knowledge of every creation.
36:81 repeats creation three times and frames the analogous act as a question of effective capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material endpoints, forgotten first origination, renewed bringing-forth, comprehensive knowledge, and capacity; I infer continuity of the returned person across those transformations. The alternative emphasizes demonstration of power without specifying how identity persists.

changed_reading.before: Return means moving an already intact subject back to a destination.
changed_reading.after: Return can reconstitute the subject across drop, living form, bone, and decay because origination itself remains within sovereign knowledge and capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah supplies a compact efficacy chain: sovereign command, willing a thing, address, and occurrence. The focus then universalizes this event structure as the malakut of every thing and turns its source into every addressee's destination.

activation_trace.role: The hand as effective authority names the power whose operation the preceding sequence displays.
Sovereign rule generalizes the efficacy sequence from one willed object to the whole domain.
The will-related thing branch makes every focus thing legible as a possible object of effective willing.
Command as an obligating demand supplies the authoritative initiation of the event.
Will and volition select the thing toward which the command's efficacy is directed.
A thing as object of willing is the hinge repeated by the focus's every-thing phrase.
Uttered speech supplies the address that mediates between will and occurrence.
Occurrence and presence in time supply both the commanded event and its realized result.

structural_cues: 36:82 uses a restrictive construction to sequence command, willing a thing, saying to it, and its occurrence.
36:83 follows immediately with the same thing root under a universal totalizer and sovereign hand-malakut construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the terms and their grammatical sequence; I infer the directional arrow will to address to occurrence and read the focus as its universalization. A live alternative lets command mean affair or state, but the saying-and-occurrence sequence still supports efficacy.

changed_reading.before: Malakut denotes the possession of things that already exist.
changed_reading.after: Malakut includes the immediate efficacy by which a willed thing occurs, so the source of existence is also the endpoint of return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the motion branch of the opening root resonate inside a conventional transcendence noun. It remains anchored by the exact root's finite swimming use, universal subject, celestial course, and recurrent lunar movement in 36:39-40. Downstream prose should retain it only as a kinetic undertone beneath transcendence, not as a replacement for the noun's primary force.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening root of praise and the final return construction.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and running contribute a latent kinetic value to the focus opening.
Return to a prior direction closes the focus with movement back toward source.
Recurrent return after departure gives the measured lunar course a visible back-turning rhythm.
The universal totalizer makes swimming a system-wide action rather than an isolated image.
The celestial course supplies the medium and bounded track of that universal motion.
The exact root explicitly denotes swimming here and activates its distant motion branch in the focus opening.

changed_reading.before: The opening praise is a static declaration before a static kingdom.
changed_reading.after: The praise also faintly resonates with an entire order swimming its assigned courses and returning within the dominion it displays.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from directional return into the branch of returning an answer or speech. It remains anchored in the focus return root and in the surah's nearby speaking hands plus command-to-being utterance. Downstream prose should mark it as metaphorical responsiveness to the originating address, never as the grammatical replacement for physical or eschatological return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final return root, especially its answer-and-speech branch, under the sovereignty of the focus.

activation_trace.role: Returning an answer or speech allows the focus return to carry a contained responsive resonance.
Intelligible speech linking speakers shows embodied agents becoming capable of response without their mouths.
The authoritative command supplies the initiating address to which created occurrence can metaphorically answer.
Uttered saying makes the origination mechanism explicitly speech-shaped.
Occurrence in time functions as the thing's immediate realized response to the address.

changed_reading.before: Return is solely spatial movement back to the sovereign.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory level, created being answers the originating command by occurring, and embodied testimony answers back again when all are returned.

strongest_changes: The all-thing register of 36:12 changes universal dominion into exhaustive retention of deeds and aftereffects.
Origination, universal assembly, and blocked self-return change return from generic homecoming into compelled creatorward presentation and reconstitution.
Speaking hands and the ownership sequence distinguish creaturely embodied agency and delegated use from the divine hand's encompassing sovereignty.
The command-will-saying-occurrence sequence of 36:82 makes malakut the efficacy by which things occur, not only title over things already present.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reuses the focus roots in functional scenes: every thing is registered, return is paired with origination and denied to autonomous movers, all swim in measured courses, hands testify and make, humans own subjected creatures, and a willed thing occurs immediately before the focus universalizes the pattern.
remaining_uncertainties: The kinetic value of the opening praise is securely root-activated but remains subordinate to transcendence.
The archival model may describe comprehensive knowledge without requiring a literal forensic retrieval mechanism.
The handle-and-linchpin baseline is branch-distant and should remain exploratory.
Return as an answer to originating speech is a contained cross-domain resonance, not a syntactic claim.
